Phone block vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume block-list capability in the binary or a companion guide covers storefront language. Xcode, Phone settings, and Connect actually separate per-number blocking from product-page copy:

  • Block This Caller (Phone, FaceTime, Messages) — system action that permanently blocks one contact or number from calling, FaceTime, and often messaging. Does not generate Chinese listing text.
  • Blocked Contacts (Settings → Phone) — the system list of numbers and contacts you have blocked. Separate from the zh-Hans description paragraph that explains block-caller value to buyers.
  • In-app block-list UI — setup wizards, blocked-number lists, unblock flows, and Block This Caller explainers. Your listing may mention block a phone number; implementing block APIs is engineering work, not listing copy.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of block flags in the binary.

Working per-number blocking in the app or system settings and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other.

3 — Silence Unknown Callers (different Phone setting — not this page)

Silence Unknown Callers (静音未知来电) sends calls from numbers not in Contacts, Mail, or Messages straight to voicemail without ringing — a blanket rule for strangers, not a permanent block of one number you choose. Block Caller (拦截来电 / 屏蔽来电 / 拉黑号码) stops a specific contact or line from calling, FaceTime, and related surfaces entirely. Listing copy for Block Caller should not describe unknown-number voicemail behavior — see Silence Unknown Callers listing guide, not here.

4 — Filter Unknown Senders & Report Junk (Messages — not Phone block)

Filter Unknown Senders (过滤未知发件人) routes texts from unknown senders into a separate Messages inbox — inbox separation, not blocking a caller from Phone. Report Junk reports spam messages to Apple or carriers — not permanently blocking a phone number from calling. Block Caller listing copy markets per-number stop-calls-and-FaceTime value — see Filter Unknown Senders listing guide and Report Junk listing guide for those distinct buyer stories.

5 — Hide Alerts, Edit Message & Tapbacks (not block)

Hide Alerts mutes notification banners for one conversation — the sender can still call and message; you just stop seeing alert pop-ups. Edit Message and Tapback reactions are messaging UX — not blocking callers. Block Caller listing copy should not describe per-thread mute badges or chat edit overlays — see Hide Alerts listing guide when mute-not-block is your hero.

FAQ

Does localizing my listing block a phone number inside the Phone app?

No. AppLocale rewrites App Store Connect metadata — name, subtitle, keywords, description, and screenshot caption lines on your zh-Hans product page. The Block This Caller action in Phone, FaceTime, or Messages, Settings → Phone → Blocked Contacts, and in-app block-list logic are system or binary work outside AppLocale scope.

How is Block Caller listing copy different from Silence Unknown Callers?

Block Caller listing copy markets permanently blocking one chosen contact or phone number — calls, FaceTime, and often Messages from that sender stop entirely. Silence Unknown Callers sends unknown numbers straight to voicemail without ringing — it does not permanently block a specific saved number you pick. Screenshot captions should name 拦截来电, 屏蔽来电, or 拉黑号码 for a named contact — not 静音未知来电 for strangers. See our Silence Unknown Callers listing guide for unknown-number auto-silence claims.

How is Block Caller different from Filter Unknown Senders, Report Junk, or Hide Alerts?

Filter Unknown Senders routes stranger texts into a separate Messages inbox — not a permanent Phone block. Report Junk reports spam messages — not blocking a caller from Phone. Hide Alerts mutes notification banners for one conversation — the sender can still call. Block Caller stops a specific contact from calls and FaceTime entirely.

What character limits apply to zh-Hans Block Caller listing fields?

App name and subtitle are each up to 30 characters on the zh-Hans row. The keyword field allows up to 100 characters. Description and screenshot caption lines have longer limits but should stay concise — especially subtitle and overlay lines that must fit on-device mockups showing blocked-contacts lists or Block This Caller confirmation sheets.

Should I claim my app replaces the Phone app or blocks every spam caller in China?

No. Listing copy should describe the per-number block, blocked-contacts list, or Block This Caller guidance your app actually ships — without promising universal spam blocking, carrier-wide enforcement, or that you are the system Phone app. AppLocale rewrites from your English source claims; we do not invent blocking coverage your binary does not support.
